featured_reviews.name: starBoy_Inc
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a cap from Urban Monkey and I’m quite impressed with the quality. The material feels durable, the stitching is neat, and the fit is comfortable — definitely a premium feel. It’s clear that a lot of attention has gone into the design and construction, which makes it a worthwhile buy if you’re looking for something stylish and long-lasting.

However, one downside is that Urban Monkey doesn’t seem to offer any kind of discounts or promotional deals, unlike other big brands. While I don’t mind paying for quality, a little price flexibility or occasional offers would make the experience even better.

Overall, great product quality, but it would be nice to see them offer more competitive pricing options.

I also purchased the connector, belt, carabiner, and keychain (sml package) from Urban Monkey, and I'm extremely disappointed with the quality. All items are made from very flimsy, low-quality metal. The hooks broke within just a week of light use. Definitely not worth the price—avoid if you're looking for durability.

featured_reviews.review_text: ***DO NOT RECOMMEND WHATSOEVER*** Terrible service. The shop is local to the apt we are staying in in Mumbai (7 kms away), but I ordered because we were not going to get a chance to visit the shop personally. Placed the order 15th of Oct, whole the website said it was a 2-5 day delivery. Tracker was updated on the 16th October to say it was waiting to be collected and stayed there, zero development. Emailed the shop twice, tried to phone twice, no answer to either. Finally got through to them a full week after placing the order, and spoke to a completely disinterested employee, only to be told to text on the order number (instead of actually dealing with us over the phone, expediting the delivery) no reply to text message, just an email from the courier to say it was with them and that they would deliver it nearly two full weeks (27th October) after raising the order...when I will be back home in my own country. Disgraceful service, DO NOT RECOMMEND WHATSOEVER, AND WILL NEVER USE AGAIN.

I recently had the pleasure of receiving exceptional service from Naziya and Reshma at Ritu Kumar's Mumbai Bandra store. We purchased a couple of beautiful dresses for a family member, but upon arriving in Jaipur for a wedding, we realized we had bought one size too big.

We were able to arrange for a master tailor  at our hotel and temporarily fix the dresses. The tailor successfully adjusted one dress, but the other design could not be altered. I reached out to Naziya, and she went out of her way to help us!
Not to worry- Naziya quickly arranged for a replacement dress to be shipped by courier to Jaipur and we received it just in time for the second gala.

This level of service truly deserves five stars! Huge thanks to Naziya and Reshma for their dedication and to Ritu Kumar for having such an outstanding team. Highly recommend!
